results.rationale: Consistency: the monitor and cuff remain recognizable, but date/time text is replaced by gibberish and several unit labels and small display symbols are altered. Instruction: the new reading is about 118/78, which does not depict hypotension. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid; neither value is below the supplied thresholds. Quality: major digits are readable, but numerous garbled labels and malformed display characters noticeably degrade the product image.

Consistency: people, hands, grass, string grid and other tiles remain preserved outside the attempted mark change. Instruction: the upper-middle O is changed to X instead of adding X in the empty upper-left winning position; the resulting board has no three-X line. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: tiles, hands and grass remain naturally rendered with clear symbols and coherent geometry.
